 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Repeat the 8-colored motif horizontally once per 4 marker."""
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows else 0
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    markers = sum(1 for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 4)
    if not cells or markers == 0:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    motif = [[1 if grid[r][c] == 8 else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
             for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    return [[8 if motif[r][c % len(motif[0])] else 0
             for c in range(markers * len(motif[0]))]
            for r in range(len(motif))]
"
